historySource.indexText: Murrah Federal Building on April 19, 1995, killed 168 people and injured over 650. The memorial is owned and operated by a private foundation. The National Park Service provides interpretive services on the Outdoor Symbolic Memorial. Established Oct. 9, 1997; redesignated as affiliated area Jan. 23, 2004.
